# CodeGang

> CodeGang is a five-engineer software studio (codegang.online) shipping production
> AI, multi-tenant platforms, and mobile apps for clients in Brazil, Australia,
> India, the USA, and Europe. The engineers in the meeting are the ones writing
> the code.

## Systems

- [Verse AI](https://www.codegang.online/work/verse-ai): Private ChatGPT for the
  enterprise. Multi-tenant RAG on a 7-layer AWS stack (NestJS, Postgres, Qdrant,
  Bedrock). Live in production in Brazil at moovehubia.com.br.
- [eMedici](https://www.codegang.online/work/emedici): Australia's leading
  medical-education Android app (Flutter). 10K+ installs, 4.9★ on the Play Store.
- [ARM Tech ERP](https://www.codegang.online/work/arm-tech): 3-module ERP for a
  cement, fleet and cold-materials trader in India, with five deep-learning
  modules (LSTM demand forecasting, autoencoder anomaly detection, trip
  profitability, invoice OCR, dealer risk scoring).
- [AI Resume Builder](https://www.codegang.online/work/ai-resume): ATS-optimized
  resumes from a pasted job description. Next.js + FastAPI + OpenAI on AWS. Live
  at nailhiring.com (USA).
- [NestFlow](https://www.codegang.online/work/nestflow): Property management for
  landlords. Containerized microservices (MongoDB, Redis, Docker). In build,
  targeting Europe.
- [Pinnacle HMS](https://www.codegang.online/work/pinnacle-hms): Hospital
  management system for Pinnacle General Hospital, India. Six role-based portals
  over 39 tables and 57 relationships. Live in production.
